title: Self-Serve Security Attestation Bundles & Pricing Experimentation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a self-serve ‘attestation bundle’ product that lets customers request, download, and attach Redwood-verified security questionnaire responses (SIG/CAIQ) and short-form customer attestations as part of onboarding and procurement. This work pairs a productized document offering with a narrow pricing experiment to understand willingness-to-pay and operational cost to provide curated evidence packs for enterprise customers.

Scope:
- Define 3 attestation bundle tiers (Basic: standardized CAIQ PDF + short FAQ; Standard: CAIQ + prefilled answers for common controls + operational evidence links; Premium: everything in Standard + engineer-verified evidence, SOC/ISO checklist summary, 1-hour onboarding call).
- Build a self-serve UI flow in Console for customers to request a bundle, choose tier, and receive downloadable artifacts and a signing token for attestations.
- Implement backend automation to assemble latest CAIQ export, attach relevant documentation links (SAML metadata, KMS attestations, runtime SLO reports), and mark bundle generation events for audit logging.
- Wire in a pricing experiment: free Basic to all, Standard priced at $X/month or one-time $Y attestation fee (A/B test pricing), Premium requires sales-assisted purchase and reserved capacity credit.
- Add telemetry: bundle requests per customer, time to deliver, manual review ratio, cost per bundle, conversion from Standard trial to paid, and churn/expansion signals.

Acceptance criteria:
- Productized Console flow that allows customers to request and download bundles without Sales for Basic/Standard.
- Backend process that compiles CAIQ + evidence links and produces a signed PDF within 48 hours (goal: <6 hours for automated-only cases).
- Pricing experiment instrumentation and cohort assignment implemented; ability to report revenue uplift or friction by 90 days.
- Clear playbook for Sales/SEs to elevate Premium requests and a simple refund/appeal process for mistaken disclosures.

Risks & open questions:
- Some evidence pieces are manual and require SRE/Infra input; need to estimate recurring operational cost.
- Legal review required for delivering signed attestations to ensure we do not create contractual liabilities (is signed PDF considered an attestation vs informational pack?).
- Data sensitivity: ensure bundle generation does not export customer-specific secrets; require RBAC on who can request bundles in Console.

Dependencies: internal SIG/CAIQ canonical export (ENG-6421), Console file download UX changes (ENG-7018), Billing & metering flags (ENG-7150), Legal review slot (LEGAL-19), Sales playbook update (PM-11022).
